text.bluf: Scorpion is a founder led local business marketing and technology firm in Lehi, UT (founder and CEO Rustin Kretz), selling websites, ads, Local Services Ads and its own AI chat assistants to home services, legal, franchise and healthcare operators. The record shows it going product first: AI lead scoring, LSA lead quality automation and a 2025-11 Clio partnership for law firms. Horus reads it Favored at 24.9; Monsoon reads Landfall at 74.2 with displacement 76.2. The one thing a rival should know: all 5 clients on record are names only, nothing in its sitemap updated in 90 days, and it publishes no pricing while its ads sell cost per signed case.
text.doing:
The positioning line, a revenue focused marketing and technology partner for local businesses in home services, legal, franchise and healthcare pairing expert teams with its own AI driven tools, decodes to a vertical agency selling software with services: one vendor for the website, the ads and the AI receptionist. The headline claim, 20+ years serving local businesses and an 8x ROI for a home services client in its LinkedIn ads, is the agency's claim; its 2021 award post claims more than 14,000 customers.

The sold mix leads with Local (score 3: LSA, a multi location vertical, Apple Business Connect API access). Core at score 2: AI Automation / Agents (24/7 AI chat with booking, Convert assistants, AI powered ads), AI Search / GEO (AI Overview and ChatGPT Atlas posts), Data & Measurement (a Chief Data Scientist, AI lead scoring, the Clio tie up), Paid Search (117 own Google ads), SEO (520 vertical articles) and Web & Product (Website first in the nav). Family scores put Local & SMB at 3.45 and Performance media at 0.97. Proprietary: Convert, Scorpion AI Chat, AI powered lead scoring and in house video and photography studios. Partners listed: Clio, Thumbtack and Apple Business Connect.

AI posture: AI sold as product rather than service, and a 2026-02-03 post says its Quality AI submits lead quality feedback to Google every hour for LSA credits.

Moves in date order: 2021, BIG Award for Business Company of the Year; undated, the AI chat launch, Apple Business Connect API access and Thumbtack joining its partnership lineup; 2025-11, the Clio partnership for law firms. News runs from 2026-02-03 to 2026-04-10.

The record lists no pricing model, though its ads sell cost per signed case. Conspicuously absent: a founding year, an employee count, jobs or an ATS (jobs count 0), a CMS, any paid social line, and a single titled case study (the 9 case study pages are vertical index pages; the own site read hit a WAF 403 on the sitemap).
text.clients:
The client type is local: home services, legal, franchise and healthcare operators. The verticals list runs from Electrical, HVAC, Pest Control, Plumbing and Roofing to Bankruptcy, Criminal defense, Family, Immigration and Personal injury law, plus Franchise, Medical, Hospital & healthcare systems and Multi-location platforms; the home market is the US from one office in Lehi, UT.

The needs read names 5 clients, 0 observed and 5 names only, so the mix read is empty. Pauls Plumbing & Heating, Midwest Mold Removal and Protector Pest Solutions are testimonials on the home page; Awesome Home and Owenby Law are case study entries on the successes page with no title the read could code. The only work the record describes comes from its own LinkedIn ads: 8x ROI, 75% above monthly lead goals and nearly 2x customer value for Awesome Home with Brandyn Nuffer, and revenue growth for Owenby Law, as the agency claims. What all five came for is inferred from the sold mix: local lead generation through websites, LSAs and AI chat. None is shared with another tracked agency; the deepen pass counted 9 case study pages, all vertical index pages dated 2026-03-31 to 2026-04-02.

The book's evidence is therefore three testimonials, two untitled entries and ad copy, for a firm claiming more than 14,000 customers.

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): very likely, moderate confidence, these trades and law firms need citation visibility in AI Overviews and map packs, which its 2026-04-10 post says already end over half of Google searches without a click; likely, low confidence, they will also need proof that AI chat and Convert bookings turn into signed jobs and cases, which no case study in the record provides.
text.house: Say and do: 2 of 2 tested lines pass and the Radar flags no gaps, but the AI Search / GEO test is unknown because the llms.txt check did not complete. Paid Search corroborated: its Transparency Center record shows 117 ads, 44 in the last 30 days (80 text, 37 video), advertiser Scorpion Design, last shown 2026-09-27, with lines such as "Signed Cases, Not Just Leads - Reduce Cost Per Signed Case" and "Stop Chasing Leads. Grow Revenue with Scorpion." Publishing cadence is marked corroborated on 63 URLs updated in 365 days, yet 0 were updated in 90 days across 1897 sitemap URLs (12 AI URLs), and the latest dated items are a podcast on 2026-04-27 and news on 2026-04-10: the machine is idle. Tags: GTM and a Meta pixel; no CMS identified, no test tools, no ABM stack; no AI crawlers blocked. LinkedIn: 5 company page ads, a floor against 101 name matches, carrying the Awesome Home 8x ROI line.
text.market:
Horus reads Scorpion Favored at 24.9, percentile 81, resilience 37.3, 16:30 on the Solar Arc (dusk, Atum), best fit The Walled Oasis at 44/100, and lists no headwind judgment at all.
